title.rendered: Content creation bigger than making people laugh — Paramount Komedy

content.rendered:
Content creator and social media influencer, Munirat Sanni, popularly known as Paramount Komedy, has urged aspiring digital creators to prioritise value and authenticity over the pursuit of viral fame, saying credibility remains the foundation of a sustainable career.

In a statement shared with Saturday Beats, she said, “Don’t chase fame alone; focus on creating value. Learn continuously, stay consistent and never stop improving your craft. Growth takes time, but if you remain authentic and disciplined, opportunities will eventually come. Most importantly, build a brand that people can trust because credibility lasts longer than viral moments.”

Paramount, who has built an online community of nearly 400,000 followers on Instagram, said her journey into content creation was inspired by a desire to combine humour with meaningful messages that educate and inspire audiences.

She said, “Paramount Komedy isn’t just about making funny videos; it’s about creating content with purpose. Whenever people see my brand, I want them to expect originality, positive energy and meaningful entertainment.”

She also highlighted the growing responsibility of influencers in shaping attitudes and behaviours, noting that many young people now look up to digital creators as role models.

“Beyond entertainment, we should encourage good values, respect, hard work and kindness. We may not be perfect, but we should always remember that our actions and words can influence thousands of lives,” she added.
